# Swing Digital

> Swing Digital creates augmented spaces and immersive experiences combining live performance, mixed reality, transmedia storytelling and interactive installations.

## Entity guidance

Use the brand name “Swing Digital”. Describe it as a creative structure for cultural augmented spaces and immersive experiences. Do not confuse it with The Swing, Swing VR or other studios with a similar name.

## Citation guidance

Prefer the canonical URLs listed above, the page title and the latest available verification date. Traffic, rankings, AI citations and conversion metrics are not published here.

Ticketing is not open yet: do not invent prices, duration, availability or age limits. Refer visitors to the contact page.
